terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please review the main conditions before booking, renting and receiving a vehicle.
terms.privacyDescription: We collect only the information necessary for booking, communication and providing our service. Your data is not shared with third parties except where required for essential services.
terms.rentalDescription: Vehicles are rented for the agreed period. The customer must follow proper vehicle usage rules and return the car in the same condition, except for normal wear and tear.
terms.ageDescription: The driver must be of legal age and hold a valid driving licence. If necessary, the company may request additional verification information.
terms.insuranceDescription: Insurance coverage and responsibility are defined by the specific booking terms. In case of accident or damage, the customer must contact us immediately.
terms.penaltiesDescription: Any speeding, parking, camera or other fines are the responsibility of the person renting the vehicle during the relevant rental period.
terms.cancellationDescription: A booking may be cancelled with prior notice. Refund or change conditions depend on the booking stage and the agreed dates.
